items.title: TrueLayer reports an AI-agent bank-payment pilot with Papa John’s
summary: On 27 November, TrueLayer said a Papa John’s AI agent completed a Pay by Bank payment during an FCA sandbox pilot involving UK banks.
According to TrueLayer, customers set spending limits with their bank; the announcement does not give a date for a general launch.
items.why: The pilot tests how retailers might combine AI-assisted ordering with bank-enforced spending limits in a future checkout flow.

items.title: Middle East advertisers report plans to test ads on AI tools
summary: In a 27 November release, EMARKETER said nearly half of surveyed Middle East ad buyers planned to place ads on AI tools within the next 12 months.
The survey involved 65 marketing and e-commerce professionals, so its findings should be read as a small-sample indication of intent rather than actual spending.
items.why: For e-commerce teams, the findings point to another potential discovery channel while underlining the need to test reach and commercial return.
